title: Morphogenesis Across n: Overlays, Emergence Thresholds, and Weak Self-Similarity in the Partition Graph
summary: We study the partition graphs $G_n$ as a growing family of discrete geometric objects and introduce a formal framework for comparing their structures across different levels. The main tool is a family of Ferrers-translation maps \[ T_τ:G_n\to G_{n+k},\qquad (T_τ(λ))'=λ'+τ', \] defined for fixed partitions $τ\vdash k$. We prove that these maps are induced graph embeddings, giving a rigorous notion of translation overlay: an induced copy of $G_n$ inside $G_{n+k}$.
